description: The cost of an images / video / voice job at every model that sells it by its own unit, the cheapest offer of each model, cheapest first, USD: kind image (quantity = images), video (seconds), tts (characters to speak), stt (minutes of audio to transcribe). Models priced per token are not in it (use estimate_cost). Each row has card_url and cite.

kind.description: what is made: image (pictures), video (seconds of video), tts (speech from text, by characters), stt (text from speech, by minutes)

quantity.description: images, seconds, characters or minutes; default 100 / 60 / 100000 / 60

name: media_cost
